svg.title: LibreYOLO YOLO9-T detection architecture
svg.desc: Inference graph, three detection towers, eight expanded building-block definitions and optional PGI training branch. Tensor sizes use channels by height by width, excluding batch.
svg.text: Input: 640 × 640, 80 classes. Tensor sizes: C × H × W, excluding batch.

g.aria-label: Decode all three scales, DFL expectation + grid/stride; sigmoid

svg.text: Final 1×1 layers have bias; no BN or activation.
Box width: 64. Class width: 80. g = groups.
CLASS: 3×3, 80; then 3×3, 80; then 1×1, 80. Output: class logits.
CLASS: 3×3, 80; then 3×3, 80; then 1×1, 80. Output: class logits.
CLASS: 3×3, 80; then 3×3, 80; then 1×1, 80. Output: class logits.
Output: B × 84 × 8,400. Apply confidence filtering and NMS.
Postprocessing is outside the neural network.
Conv = Conv2d + BatchNorm2d + SiLU. Unmarked strides are 1.

g.text: k: kernel size, s: stride, p: padding
Cout is given by the stage label.
Spatial size changes from H × W to H/2 × W/2.
Residual enabled; input and output widths match.
Optional identity BN branch is disabled here.
After fusion: one Conv2d 3×3 followed by SiLU.
Tiny stem: a, b, c, d each have 16 channels.
Each pool: k=5, s=1, p=2. H and W stay fixed.
a, b, c, d: C/2 channels each. Concat: 2C.
Three RepNBottlenecks in the left branch.
Each branch: C/4 channels. Output: C/2.

svg.text: B5: SPPELAN gives A5 (128 × 20 × 20). Upsample ×2, concat B4, RepNCSPELAN gives A4 (96 × 40 × 40).
A4: upsample ×2, concat B3, RepNCSPELAN gives A3 (64 × 80 × 80).
A3, A4 and A5 feed a separate DDetect head for the auxiliary box, DFL and classification losses.
Combined loss = main loss + auxiliary weight × auxiliary loss. enable_aux() defaults to 0.25. This branch is not called during inference.
Original diagram. Architecture source: LibreYOLO (MIT), adapted from MultimediaTechLab/YOLO (MIT).
